response.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT ta.telescref,
       ta.avg_modindex,
       ta.avg_modindex - ga.overall_avg_modindex AS excess_over_group_average,
       ta.avg_modindex / ga.overall_avg_modindex AS ratio_to_group_average
FROM telescope_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > ga.overall_avg_modindex
ORDER BY ratio_to_group_average DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each telescope's average is computed from its non-NULL modulation-index values; telescopes with no non-NULL values are excluded from the per-telescope averages and the group average.
